history.content: How do I schedule a report to be emailed every week?

To schedule a report to be emailed every week, follow these steps:

1. Filter or search your reports to locate the one you want to send on a recurring basis.
2. Select the envelope icon from the Email Scheduled column to open the Schedule Email Delivery pop-up window.
3. Add each email alias into the Recipient Email Addresses field, separated by commas.
4. Choose to email the report as an XLSX or CSV file.
5. Open the Delivery Frequency dropdown menu and select a weekly delivery frequency.
6. If you chose a Weekly until frequency, use the second Delivery Frequency field to choose which day of the week to send the recurring report.
7. Enter when to stop sending the recurring report into the End Date field.
8. Review the preview next to the information icon to confirm your selections.
9. Click the Running Total toggle switch if you want each recurring report to cover the period from the report’s start date through the most recent report delivery date; otherwise, each report will include only the most recent week’s data.
10. Click Schedule to initiate the recurring email delivery.

The report will be sent once the first recurring date arrives, for example, on the chosen day of the week.

This procedure applies to scheduling recurring reports generally and can be done through the report interface or with Vera.

inputs.question: Can I change those settings later?

outputs.answer:
Yes, you can change the settings of a scheduled report later. You can update the delivery schedule, recipients, file format, and delivery frequency at any time. To do this, locate the report you want to edit, select the pencil icon in the Email Scheduled column to open the scheduling window, make your desired changes, and then apply them. You can also stop the recurring delivery if you wish.

Additionally, if you scheduled the report using Vera, you can locate the existing chat and ask Vera to apply your desired changes to the report delivery schedule.

metadata.header: Generate, manage, or send a report with Vera › Send and schedule a report with Vera › Change an existing report delivery schedule

documents.page_content:
### Change an existing report delivery schedule

You can change a report’s delivery schedule or stop recurring delivery at any time by [locating an existing chat](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15492472-locate-or-manage-an-existing-chat-with-vera#h_3c2d8326be), then using the chat box to ask Vera to apply your desired changes. These changes can include different recipients, file formats, and delivery frequencies, for example.

metadata.header: Generate, manage, or send a report › Send a report › Schedule recurring email delivery

documents.page_content:
### Schedule recurring email delivery

Follow these steps to schedule a recurring report:

1. Filter or search your reports to locate the one you want to send on a recurring basis.
2. Select the envelope icon from the **Email Scheduled** column. This will open the **Schedule Email Delivery** pop-up window.
3. Add each email alias into the **Recipient Email Addresses** field, separated by commas.
4. Choose to email the report as an **XLSX** or **CSV** file, depending on your preference.
5. Open the **Delivery Frequency** dropdown menu and select how often we should send this report to the recipients you entered.
   1. Refer to [Delivery frequency](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343665-reports-overview#h_22b898e667) for more information on each delivery frequency.
6. Enter when we should stop sending the recurring report into the **End Date** field.
7. If you chose a **Weekly until** frequency, use the second **Delivery Frequency** field to choose which day of the week to send the recurring report.
8. If you chose a **Monthly until** frequency, use the second **Delivery Frequency** field to choose which day of the month to send the recurring report.
9. Review the preview next to the information icon to confirm that your selections are correct.
10. Click the **Running Total** toggle switch if you’d like each recurring report to use the report’s start date through the most recent report delivery date. Otherwise, each report will include only the most recent day/week/month’s data, depending on the frequency you selected.
11. Click **Schedule** to initiate the recurring email delivery.

We’ll send the report once the first recurring date arrives. For example, if you selected **Monthly until** and **Last Day of Month**, we’ll send the first report at the end of this month. Refer to Schedule one-time email delivery if you’d like to send the report immediately.

metadata.header: Generate, manage, or send a report › Send a report › Edit or stop a report schedule

documents.page_content:
### Edit or stop a report schedule

Follow these steps to update the cadence of a report that you previously scheduled for recurring delivery:

1. Filter or search your reports to locate the one you want to edit.
2. Select the pencil icon from the **Email Scheduled** column. This will open the **Schedule Email Delivery** pop-up window that you used when you first created the email schedule.
   1. You must hover your cursor over the report row for the pencil icon to appear in the **Email Scheduled** column.
3. Apply any desired changes to the email delivery recipients, file format, or delivery frequency.
4. Click **Stop Schedule** to cancel all future scheduled email deliveries, if desired.
5. Select **Update Changes** to apply your edits, or **Cancel** to leave the original schedule unchanged.

metadata.header: Provider Level Data (PLD) Insights report overview › PLD report scheduling › Delivery frequency

documents.page_content:
### Delivery frequency

You’ll define a delivery frequency when you create a scheduled report. You can edit or stop the delivery schedule at any time. Refer to [Send a PLD report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10774835-generate-or-manage-a-provider-level-data-pld-insights-report#h_54fbb1568f) for instructions on how to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery.

| **Delivery frequency category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **One time** | Generate and send the report only once. If you plan to schedule recurring email delivery, consider first selecting **One time** to send it immediately, then proceed with defining a recurring frequency. |
| **Daily** | Generate and send the report every day up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Weekly** | Generate and send the report every week, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Monthly** | Generate and send the report every month, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Custom** | Generate and send the report at a repeating daily, weekly, or monthly cadence of your choice. For example, set up a custom frequency of every two weeks. |
| **Template status - Active** | Allow the report’s delivery frequency settings to be executed until the **End Date (optional)** you specify is reached, or until you change the template’s status to **Inactive**. |
| **Template status - Inactive** | Stop the report’s delivery frequency settings from being executed until you change the template’s status back to **Active**. |

metadata.header: Generate, manage, or send a report › Send a report › Schedule one-time email delivery

documents.page_content:
### Schedule one-time email delivery

Follow these steps to send a report once:

1. Filter or search your reports to locate the one you want to send on a recurring basis.
2. Select the envelope icon from the **Email Scheduled** column. This will open the **Schedule Email Delivery** pop-up window.
3. Add each email alias into the **Recipient Email Addresses** field, separated by commas.
4. Choose to email the report as an **XLSX** or **CSV** file, depending on your preference.
5. Open the **Delivery Frequency** dropdown menu and select **One time now**
6. Select **Send**.

We’ll immediately send the report to the inboxes of the email alias(es) you entered.

metadata.header: Generate or manage a Provider Level Data (PLD) Insights report › Send a PLD report

documents.page_content:
### Schedule email delivery for an existing report template

Follow these steps to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery for an existing report template:

1. Search or filter the **Provider Level Data** table to locate the desired report template.
2. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column.
3. Follow steps 5 through 16 of the Generate a PLD report from the Insights app workflow.

### Edit a report delivery schedule

Follow these steps to change an existing one-time or recurring report delivery schedule:

1. Search or filter the **Provider Level Data** table to locate the desired report template.
2. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column.
3. Follow steps 5 through 16 of the Generate a PLD report from the Insights app workflow to choose the report’s new delivery schedule and apply your changes.

metadata.header: Reports overview › Report scheduling › Delivery frequency

documents.page_content:
### Delivery frequency

You’ll define a delivery frequency when you create a scheduled report. Refer to [Send a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report#h_b804efd090) for instructions on how to schedule on-time or recurring email delivery.

| **Delivery Frequency Category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **One time now** | Send the report only once. If you plan to schedule email delivery, consider first selecting **One time now** to send it immediately, then proceed with defining a recurring frequency. |
| **Daily until** | Send the report every day up until the **End Date** you specify. |
| **Weekly until** | Send the report every week up until the **End Date** you specify, and on the day of the week of your choice. |
| **Monthly until*** | Send the report every month up until the **End Date** you specify, and on the day of the month of your choice. |

metadata.header: Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › Send an NLD Insights report

documents.page_content:

### Edit a report delivery schedule

Follow these steps to change an existing one-time or recurring report delivery schedule:

1. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column of the desired report template.
2. Follow steps 5 through 16 of the Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app workflow to choose the report’s new delivery schedule and apply your changes.

history.content: How do I schedule a report to be emailed every week?

To schedule a report to be emailed every week, follow these steps:

1. Filter or search your reports to locate the one you want to send on a recurring basis.
2. Select the envelope icon from the Email Scheduled column to open the Schedule Email Delivery pop-up window.
3. Add each email alias into the Recipient Email Addresses field, separated by commas.
4. Choose to email the report as an XLSX or CSV file.
5. Open the Delivery Frequency dropdown menu and select a weekly delivery frequency.
6. If you chose a Weekly until frequency, use the second Delivery Frequency field to choose which day of the week to send the recurring report.
7. Enter when to stop sending the recurring report into the End Date field.
8. Review the preview next to the information icon to confirm your selections.
9. Click the Running Total toggle switch if you want each recurring report to cover the period from the report’s start date through the most recent report delivery date; otherwise, each report will include only the most recent week’s data.
10. Click Schedule to initiate the recurring email delivery.

The report will be sent once the first recurring date arrives, for example, on the chosen day of the week.

This procedure applies to scheduling recurring reports generally and can be done through the report interface or with Vera.
